objective: Test whether the cross-component effects exposed by the induced-interaction audit factor exactly through local component state plus a small global scheduler coordinate.

scheduler_candidate.F: number of components with nonempty local blocked-frontier set, capped at 2
scheduler_candidate.G: number of components with open columns, capped at 2

anti_circularity: no restored deleted residual masks in the scheduler
falsifier: any mismatch between monolithic R/F/G/H and componentwise reconstruction
